_about: Where each character's locked reference voiceprint comes from (scripts/voice_drift.py --make-refs writes <id>.json and a few seconds of <id>.mp3). A story take the owner approved beats a library sample; `provisional` = a library sample made before the 2026-11-10 recast or with another direction: replace it with the first approved story take of that character (then --make-refs <id>). Old samples are named for the old roster: voices/samples/elder.mp3 is Algenib (now the stranger), stranger.mp3 is Charon (now the elder), buh.mp3 is Achird (Milo).

narrator.note: the Roblox narrator (owner 2026-11-10: 's3_gemini_orus.mp3 is good'): the s3 raw take through tts.py's speed-up path (out/voice_match is not committed; scripts/voice_match/replay_s3.py rebuilds it from the raw take). Replace with the first approved story take, then --make-refs narrator,narrator_roblox
